name: VisuLogic
intro: VisuLogic是一个旨在评估多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）视觉推理能力的新基准。它包含1000个经过人工验证的问题，涵盖六个类别，旨在避免基于语言的推理捷径，从而更严格地评估视觉推理能力。该基准测试揭示了当前MLLMs在视觉推理方面存在的显著差距，大多数模型准确率低于30%。
org: University of Science and Technology of China, Xi'an Jiaotong University, Zhejiang University, Shang
intro_en: VisuLogic is a new benchmark designed to evaluate the visual reasoning abilities of multimodal large language models (MLLMs). It contains 1,000 manually verified questions across six categories, aiming to avoid language-based reasoning shortcuts for a more rigorous assessment of visual reasoning. The benchmark reveals significant gaps in current MLLMs' visual reasoning, with most models scoring below 30% accuracy.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2504.15279, Sections 3.1-3.3 (pp.4-5) and Section 4.1 (p.6).. VisuLogic uses Playwright to collect public web pages, cleans HTML noise, serializes candidates to JSONL, validates image existence and format, and deduplicates text by lexical overlap and images by perceptual hash. Every benchmark item then receives a full manual check and expert labels before assignment to six reasoning classes. The benchmark contains 1,000 four-choice questions. A separate same-domain candidate pool is processed with the same validation workflow and explicit non-overlap checks to produce a 4,296-item supplemental training set; it is not split from the 1,000 benchmark items. Evaluation compares direct-image MLLMs, text-only LLMs given GPT-4o captions, humans, and random choice. Model branches are evaluated with Non-CoT, CoT, and Hint prompts; CoT is the default, while GPT-4o generates Hint text from the reference solution. Accuracy is reported.
